acceptedAnswer.text: Our pre-roll menu rotates based on availability. We typically stock standard flower pre-rolls and infused options, including hash rosin, THCa diamond-infused, and kief-coated joints available as singles and multi-packs. Browse the live menu for current stock.

An infused pre-roll is a joint that’s been enhanced with cannabis concentrates such as hash rosin, THCa diamonds, or kief in addition to the ground flower inside. This makes them significantly more potent than a standard pre-roll. They’re best suited to experienced consumers.

Prices vary depending on the product and format. Standard pre-rolls start at lower price points, while premium infused packs are priced higher to reflect the concentrate content. See the menu for current pricing.

children.html:
Not all pre-rolls are created equal. We carry options across the spectrum so you can find what fits your tolerance, your occasion, and your budget.

Standard pre-rolls

Ground flower, packed and ready. Great for everyday use, sharing, or if you just want something reliable without any extras. Available as singles and multi-packs.

Infused pre-rolls

For buyers who want more. Our infused options are packed with premium flower and enhanced with concentrates including hash rosin, THCa diamonds, and kief coatings. These hit differently. If you’re experienced and want a stronger, longer-lasting effect, this is where to start.

Our inventory rotates. Browse the current menu to see exactly what’s in stock.

Depending on what’s in stock, you’ll typically find:

  • Singles: One and done. Good for trying something new or keeping it casual
  • Multi-packs: Better value, stocked up. Ideal if you have a go-to strain or format
  • Mini packs: Smaller joints in larger quantities, great for sharing or lighter sessions
  • Infused singles and packs: Hash rosin, diamond-infused, and kief-coated options for a more potent experience

Not sure what to go for? If you’re newer to cannabis, a standard pre-roll is the easier starting point. If you’re experienced and want something with more kick, an infused option is worth it. Read our beginner’s guide to weed for more context.

Pre-rolls are the most straightforward way to consume cannabis flower. No grinder, no papers, no technique required. You open the pack, and you’re ready. That’s the appeal.

For people who don’t roll their own or want consistent results every time, pre-rolls are the practical choice. For buyers who want a more elevated experience without setting up a full dab rig or concentrate setup, infused pre-rolls sit in an ideal middle ground.

They’re also easy to share, transport, and store.

Prefer a different format? Browse our edibles, cartridges, concentrates, and live resin—all available for delivery or pickup.
How to Order Pre-Rolls in DC
